title: Real-Time Order Event Streaming Platform
raw_text: Calderon Fashion Group processes roughly 90,000 orders daily across 11 markets and currently settles them through nightly batch. We require a real-time streaming layer, with Kafka carrying order events from commerce and warehouse systems, landing in a Databricks lakehouse, and serving a consolidated view. Late-arriving and out-of-order events must be handled explicitly rather than dropped. The platform scope covers ingestion, modelling, and operational monitoring of the pipelines themselves. Market-currency normalisation and returns are in scope; downstream finance system replacement is not.
requirements: Kafka ingestion of order events from commerce and warehouse systems
Databricks lakehouse modelling with explicit late-event handling
Operational monitoring of pipeline health, excluding downstream finance replacement
